description: This PHP class 'RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor' is part of the OrangeHRM project. It handles processing for employee termination events, specifically retrieving and managing data related to employee counts and event triggering within the registration system.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeTerminationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing employee termination events, including retrieving the count of inactive employees and determining if such an event should be triggered based on employee count changes.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the event type identifier for employee termination events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Collects and returns event-related data, including the count of relevant employees.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether an event should be saved or triggered based on employee count logic.
